_doc: V31: English sources must not carry Hangul (every locale reviewer hit it; the validator rejects Hangul in targets).

marketing:v12.terms.universityInfo.p.en: University information in the service is based on published sources: Korea's official university disclosure service (Academy Info), Study in Korea, and each university's own official material. Information that changes between intakes is shown with its source and the date it was checked. Public university pages are for information; what you are eligible for, and what you need to prepare, is shown in the student platform after you sign in.
marketing:v12.terms.universityInfo.p.why: Hangul in English source; 'a particular member' stiff

marketing:v20.uni.why.breadthBody.en: Disclosed to Academy Info, Korea's official university disclosure service, for the {{year}} survey. It shows how wide the choice is once you are here.
